name: bundle_view
description: Container-level metadata view: one row per first-class Bundle persisted by this project. Metadata-only (FR-011) — nested clinical content is NOT flattened here; it is promoted to first-class resources covered by the other views (Principle VI). Default column set is an informed, reviewable default (FR-002), not a finalized analytics-team contract.

where.description: Scope the view to Bundles persisted by this project's processor (FR-005): match this processor's provenance tag (processed-by = ecr-fhir-processor), version-agnostic. Excludes unrelated Bundle resources on the same server.
